literature_evidence_records.material_form: Diacylglycerol phosphate / phosphatidic acid standardized phospholipid
literature_evidence_records.search_query: phosphatidic acid resistance training lean body mass randomized trial Hoffman

qualifying_human_studies.title: Efficacy of phosphatidic acid ingestion on lean body mass, muscle thickness and strength gains in resistance-trained men.
qualifying_human_studies.primary_endpoint: lean body mass, 1RM squat and bench press strength
qualifying_human_studies.outcome: Statistically significant increases in 1RM squat strength and a trend toward greater lean body mass in resistance-trained men receiving phosphatidic acid compared to placebo.

verification_provenance.authoritative_live_title: Efficacy of phosphatidic acid ingestion on lean body mass, muscle thickness and strength gains in resistance-trained men.
verification_provenance.abstract_evidence_quote: Phosphatidic acid (PA) has been reported to activate the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) signaling pathway and is thought to enhance the anabolic effects of resistance training.

literature_evidence_records.population_context: Resistance-trained adults undergoing supervised progressive training
literature_evidence_records.applicability_decision: Phosphatidic acid supported at >= 750 mg/day in resistance-trained adults for strength and lean mass adaptation.

literature_evidence_records.material_form: Fermented black soybean (Glycine max) Touchi water extract (alpha-glucosidase inhibitor)
literature_evidence_records.search_query: Touchi extract fermented soybean alpha-glucosidase borderline diabetes Fujita

qualifying_human_studies.title: Long-term ingestion of a fermented soybean-derived Touchi-extract with alpha-glucosidase inhibitory activity is safe and effective in humans with borderline and mild type-2 diabetes.
qualifying_human_studies.primary_endpoint: HbA1c and postprandial blood glucose levels
qualifying_human_studies.dose: 900 mg/day (300 mg three times daily with meals)
qualifying_human_studies.outcome: Statistically significant reductions in HbA1c and postprandial glucose levels without gastrointestinal adverse effects in subjects with borderline or mild diabetes.

verification_provenance.authoritative_live_title: Long-term ingestion of a fermented soybean-derived Touchi-extract with alpha-glucosidase inhibitory activity is safe and effective in humans with borderline and mild type-2 diabetes.
verification_provenance.abstract_evidence_quote: In the present complementary study, the effects of powdered Houji-tea with or without (placebo) TE, a formula designed to enhance good compliance, were monitored in a 3-mo double-blind randomized group comparison study with placebo controls in humans with borderline and mild type-2 diabetes (n = 36).

literature_evidence_records.population_context: Adults with borderline or mild impaired fasting/postprandial glucose
literature_evidence_records.applicability_decision: Touchi fermented soybean extract supported at >= 300 mg per meal (900 mg/day) for postprandial glycemic support.
